title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: solver.cpp:175 onward assembles conservative compressible viscous flow residual; actual production executable revision not established.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS reader, mixed geometry, cell-face graph and METIS adjacency are source-evident; independent geometry oracle not run.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp assembles face residual and global norms. Final source tests fresh-gradient BDF residual, but historical production binary origin and exact target misses are unproven.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: numerics.cpp implements Roe and Rusanov, with report case choices. Actual production revision remains unknown; no independent flux convergence study.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp farfield/slip/no-slip paths and output wall semantics exist; raw surface checks are available but actual source version of runs is unbound.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:1308–1318 uses CFD_RECON_SCALE=0.5 in three manifest cases, explicitly disclosed; :1414–1456 permits CFD_GRAD_DAMP=0.5 in M2 inviscid, omitted from report. No order study.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Source implements Barth/Venkatakrishnan and positivity fallback; run manifest names Venkatakrishnan for Re200 and scaling exceptions. Exact producing source unproven.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:487–542 computes viscous wall stress and projects onto tangent; raw laminar cases have force plots dominated by startup, and production source revision is unproven.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Source LU-SGS and optional matrix-free GMRES; output steady inner statistics vary across final revisions, and actual binary revision is not bound.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:1875–1950,2240–2311 implements BDF1 startup, BDF2 and fresh-gradient total residual target. io.cpp:61–65 writes only current U and solver.cpp:1872–1873 resets both histories/time loop after restart. Metadata git_revision=null; strict target production origin remains unproven.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: main.cpp:287–320 root-only preprocessing, METIS and neighbor halo; raw np1/8 Re20 Cd differs ~1.1%, not order-one. Production source revision is unknown.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
